calls.stepExplanation: Authenticate using API key credentials to obtain an access token and refresh token.
Bind the obtained access token to the current websocket/session context (bind access token).
Create a new solution and store its id in context for subsequent operations.
Create a new context (private) under the newly created solution and save the contextId.
Add a user 'alice' to the created context with a sample public key.
Fetch the list of users from the context to confirm 'alice' is present.
List contexts of an existing (first) solution to show how to query contexts under a solution.
Retrieve detailed information about the newly created context.
Update the context properties (change scope to public) and store the operation result.
List all contexts available to the token to demonstrate a global listing operation.
List inboxes for the created context to show usage of the inbox APIs.
Retrieve list of threads in the created context to demonstrate thread APIs.
List stores for the created context to show store-related API usage.
List solutions accessible to the token to demonstrate solution listing.
Retrieve the list of API keys to show usage of manager endpoints.
